messages:
maria-marketing: Heads-up: final assets needed for the release post. changelog URL + canonical docs link, plus a short benchmark line for the headline. canary plan was APAC then global after 2h, right?

sam-eng: Correct. changelog: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-03-23-changelog (stable). docs canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/launch/2026-03-optimize. Canary snippet: start 11:00 PDT, APAC only, initial 5%, promote at 13:00 PDT if metrics ok.

maria-marketing: Good. please paste the YAML we can include in support playbook. also we want to call out latency@256 and cost reduction in the headline.

sam-eng: YAML: ```
rollout:
  canary:
    start: "2026-03-23T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step_pct: 10
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00"
```

ellie-product: Suggested headline blurb: "95th pctl latency (256 tokens, gpu-a100, int8): 42ms; ~3.1x cost savings vs fp16." I can expand to a paragraph.

maria-marketing: Perfect. Nate, can you schedule webinar ~90m after global promote? we want live demo of ramp.

nate-growth: Scheduling webinar for 14:30 PDT. i'll wire registration and embed on the post.

maria-marketing: Routing: enterprise leads go to AE queue. Jon, is webhook ready?

jon-sre: Webhook ready. deploy-bot will trigger /support/lead-route on changelog publish and tag enterprise when company_size>200. Example payload: {"lead":"ACME Corp","tier":"enterprise","source":"launch_post_2026-03-23"}. i'll add to support playbook in ~30m.

sam-eng: FYI if marketing shortens canary (faster promote) we need notice by 09:30 PDT to adjust autoscale.

maria-marketing: Noted. final publish checklist: changelog link (sam) ✅ docs canonical (sam) ✅ benchmark blurb (ellie) ✅ webhook routing (jon) ✅ webinar embed & reg (nate) ✅ speakers list (maria by EOD). deploy-bot: publish hook set?

deploy-bot: Scheduled publish hook set for 2026-03-23T10:00:00-07:00. If changes after 09:30 PDT, ping #release-war-room.

maria-marketing: Thanks all 680 will post final blog draft here for a quick read before publish.
